from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashDisclosure(BaseModel):
    """A cash balance line item extracted from a single document's financial statements."""
    entity_name: str | None = Field(description="The company or entity the financial statement belongs to")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact text of the line item label (e.g., 'Cash and cash equivalents')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash balance")
    period_date: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date associated with the balance")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency denomination, e.g., USD")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_disclosures: list[CashDisclosure]
